functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate case activities for 100% of systematic actions, such as disputes aging process, and ensure notifications are triggered for all relevant users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive coverage of case activity generation and user notifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately generate case activities and notifications for the correct user in 99.9% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct handling of case activities and notifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate case activities and notifications within 500 milliseconds of the systematic action being triggered.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time processing of actions, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to generate case activities and notifications for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous availability for generating case activities and notifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt case activity and notification data using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive data, requiring protection during transmission.

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must derive heating and cooling unit definitions within 200 milliseconds of reading the initialization data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time processing of initialization data, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to read initialization data and derive unit definitions for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous availability for reading and deriving unit definitions.

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must set over temperature values for 100% of temperature monitoring points.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive coverage of over temperature settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately set over temperature values with a deviation of no more than 0.1 degrees Fahrenheit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct temperature control.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must detect and respond to temperature deviations within 100 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time temperature monitoring, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to monitor and control temperature for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous availability for temperature monitoring and control.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure safe operation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves safety-critical temperature control, requiring strict adherence to operational constraints.
